CONF_A.description: fresh data + fresh NP trainings, all six formula families x both observation classes (12 toys)
CONF_A.minimum_first_pass: 1 new data-generation seed x 2 NP training seeds x 12 toys = 24 NP runs
CONF_A.full: 2 data seeds x 2 training seeds x 12 = 48
CONF_A.generator: models/s1_generate.py unchanged (documented prior / noise / fixed-bank design), same subject counts and split protocol
CONF_A.data_seeds: new fixed ids, verified unused by every existing outputs/models run before generation (recorded in confirmation_manifest.json)
CONF_A.training: frozen architecture and the existing per-model beta (registry) with new training seeds; no seed chosen with T; Stage A reported for every run
CONF_A.evaluation: locked algorithm only, E02 locked baseline alongside; all runs reported with exact denominators

one_factor_at_a_time: new generic bank / randomized bank subsampling (fixed banks)

CONF_C.status: requires a separately reviewed registry of unseen structural families (additive basis with bias, sparse interactions, gated multiplicative, mixed nonlinearity k=6-8) plus rotation-symmetric negative controls; not designed in this wave

aggregation: by family and data seed; search seeds are not replicates
compute_note: one NP training is ~300-500 epochs on 8000 subjects (GPU hours); CONF-A is not run inside wave 3 (see README)
